summary: First-iteration full-stack testing of GRAVITY ENGINEERING WORKS ERP. Backend: 20/20 pytest tests passed covering auth (login/logout/me/role-check), warehouses, products (CRUD+SKU uniqueness+adjust+stock txns+low_stock filter+_id exclusion+warehouse_name enrichment), suppliers, customers, leads (CRUD+status patch+invalid status), purchase orders (auto PO-numbering, totals, /receive stocks-up + idempotency), full sales flow (Quotation->SalesOrder->confirm deducts stock->Invoice->payment progresses UNPAID->PARTIAL->PAID->Dispatch with auto DC-numbering), insufficient-stock rejection, dashboard summary, all 3 reports endpoints, user management (admin creates employee, employee can read but not delete and not list users, admin cannot self-delete). Frontend: login page renders, login redirects to /, all 11 sidebar nav routes work (Dashboard, Products, Warehouses, Suppliers, Purchase Orders, Customers, Leads, Quotations, Sales Orders, Invoices, Dispatches, Reports, Users), dashboard shows KPIs/lead funnel/low-stock alerts populated from seeded data, Products page lists 6 seeded items with warehouse_name enrichment, Leads kanban shows 5 columns (NEW/CONTACTED/QUOTED/WON/LOST) with the 4 seeded lead cards in correct columns. No console errors on any tested page.

issues: Recharts logs benign 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings during route transitions before container measures. Chart renders correctly afterward but Revenue chart looks empty when there is only 1 data point. Consider showing an empty-state if sales_trend has < 2 points.

action_items: (Optional polish) Improve empty/single-point state for Recharts LineChart on Dashboard 'Revenue (Last 6 Months)' to avoid the resize warnings and show a friendlier empty UI.
(Optional) seed at least one demo invoice/sales order so the dashboard Revenue chart looks meaningful out of the box.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1042 lines — consider splitting into routers/ subpackage (auth, products, sales, crm, reports) per code-review guideline (>700 lines).
CORS uses explicit origins from FRONTEND_URL env (good). allow_credentials=True works with samesite=none; secure cookies (good for HTTPS preview).
All MongoDB queries explicitly project away _id (verified — no _id leaked in any tested response).
Bcrypt hash format starts with $2b$ (verified via login flow — passwords work).
seed_admin is idempotent and updates existing admin password if env changes (good).
No brute-force lockout implemented on /auth/login (playbook recommendation): consider adding rate-limit / lockout after 5 fails. Not blocking.
Employees can edit/create products/orders/etc.; only DELETE endpoints are admin-only. Matches problem statement spec.
calc_totals is reused across PO/Quotation/SO/Invoice — good DRY.
next_doc_number uses an atomic find_one_and_update on counters — race-safe.
test_credentials: admin@gravityengineering.com / Admin@123 (seeded on startup, verified working)
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds on startup: 2 warehouses, 6 products (incl. 2 low-stock), 3 customers, 2 suppliers, 4 leads (one per main status). One TEST_ invoice/SO/dispatch created during sales-flow pytest and left in DB; future runs will accumulate TEST_ data unless cleaned.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_gew_erp.py (20 tests). Re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_gew_erp.py -v. Frontend smoke-tested via Playwright: login + all sidebar routes load cleanly, dashboard/products/leads render with seeded data and no console errors. UI form-create flows (new product/warehouse/lead/SO/invoice) were not exercised end-to-end via Playwright but their backend equivalents passed. If next iteration adds new features, focus UI tests on the form-modal create+edit flows (the create modals use data-testid='form-*' fields per Products.jsx/Leads.jsx).
